correctness.rationale: For strictly biased two-neighbor medians the weighted absolute-deviation minimizer is the favored neighbor opinion, so all updates are a lazy stochastic linear map; averaging vertices have two positive neighbor arcs. Every proper closed interval must begin at R and end at L and each consecutive R-to-L median pair together with intermediate A sites is a closed communicating class. Mixed R/L words have exactly J such recurrent classes; monochromatic reduced words (including empty) have one. Lazy finite Markov chains converge to classwise constants and harmonic transient extensions. Conditional on k median sites, exactly j cyclic R-runs and j L-runs give the factor k/j times two run compositions; binomially place sites to derive the full distribution and the differentiated-binomial closed consensus formula. With exact-half medians any interval with two T endpoints is cohesive, yielding two disjoint iff at least four T. Independently checked recurrent SCC counts for all 3267 type words n<=7 and probability identities 40 rational configurations. This is bounded corroboration, not an infinite proof.
